patches.value: U_Z is the integer subalgebra of the universal enveloping algebra of sl2(C) generated by all divided powers of the abstract raising and lowering Chevalley generators, for integers r>=0. Under the given representation these generators act as x^r/r!=X_r and y^r/r!=Y_r on V. Here the abstract generators are the first and second standard Chevalley matrices displayed in the definition of L_Z; the representation need not be faithful.

value.declaration: Fix an arbitrary K-linear subspace W0 for the invariance implication at the end of S003.

patches.old: Hence every K-subspace invariant under red(x),red(y) is invariant under their powers, K-scalar multiples and compositions, so is invariant under every F_ij.
patches.new: Fix any K-subspace W0 and assume L1: it is invariant under red(x),red(y). Iteration gives invariance under their powers, and K-linearity of W0 gives invariance under scalar multiples and compositions, so W0 is invariant under every F_ij. Discharge L1 and universally quantify W0.

value.text: Choose a nonzero w in W using F001 and define its unique beta-coordinate tuple c using N005, so w=sum_{i in I} c_i beta_i. At least one coefficient is nonzero: if every coefficient were zero, the sum would be zero, contrary to the choice of w. Hence there exists k in I with c_k!=0.

produces.statement: There exists k in I with c_k!=0.

value.text: Choose j with c_j!=0 using F003. For each i in I, the matrix-unit definition gives F_ij w=c_j beta_i. F001 puts this vector in W. Since K is a field and c_j!=0, scalar multiplication by c_j^(-1) puts beta_i in W. Thus W contains every basis vector and all their K-linear combinations; W=V(K). Discharge L2 and combine with the zero branch to obtain W={0} or W=V(K) under L1. Discharge L1 to obtain the stated implication for W.

produces.statement: If W is invariant under red(x),red(y),red(h), then W={0} or W=V(K).
